verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a plausible capability for an AI API platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents routing, failover, caching, BYOK, budgets and observability for AI Gateway. Nothing shows a way to schedule one-off or recurring jobs or workflows, and Vercel host-platform features would not count toward this product anyway.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
